config.bearings.title: Bearings
config.bearings.requireCompassForCoordin: Hide coordinates and facing unless you carry a compass.
config.bearings.requireClockForTime.tool: Show the time and moon phase only while you carry a clock.
config.bearings.showDeathLocation.toolti: A recovery compass shows your last death location.
config.bearings.onlyBasicInfo.tooltip: F3 shows only the game version, FPS, system stats and what your items unlock. Also disables debug charts and location, profiling and game mode shortcuts.
config.bearings.opsSeeEverything.tooltip: Operators, and singleplayer worlds with cheats on, get the full F3 without items.
config.bearings.opsOnlyInCreative.toolti: Operators only get the full F3 while in Creative mode.
